proposals.before: In 1736, when the Qianlong Emperor took the throne, Chao reported that flood-hit districts had not technically qualified as disaster areas. The emperor replied: 'Even if the floods have not risen to the level of a declared disaster, you must still relieve the people with special care and keep the poor from losing their livelihoods.'
proposals.after: In 1735, when the Qianlong Emperor took the throne, Chao reported that flood-hit districts had not technically qualified as disaster areas. The emperor replied: 'Even if the floods have not risen to the level of a declared disaster, you must still relieve the people with special care and keep the poor from losing their livelihoods.'
proposals.reason: 雍正十三年 corresponds to AD 1735, and Gaozong's accession occurred in that year, not 1736.

proposals.before: After Yinpei was transferred to Fujian, Governor Chang Jun protected Hongsui. Qilang cried injustice and impeached Zhaolin, who memorialized in turn.
proposals.after: After Yinpei was transferred to Fujian, Governor Chang Jun shielded Hongsui and impeached Zhaolin, citing Qilang's cry of injustice. Zhaolin also memorialized the throne.
proposals.reason: The subject of 劾兆麟 is Governor Chang Jun; 以七郎呼冤 gives the grounds for his impeachment, not Qilang as the impeaching subject.

proposals.before: In 1789, blaming slack Fujian governance on him, Jingsu was punished retroactively and exiled to Ili.
proposals.after: In 1789, citing slack Fujian governance, the emperor held the late Jingsu accountable and exiled his son Zhao to Ili.
proposals.reason: Jingsu died in s0189; the graphically transmitted 戍召 continues the punishment through his son 炤 (Zhao), who was named in s0192.

proposals.before: In 1794 he was released and allowed to return.
proposals.after: In 1794 Zhao was released and allowed to return.
proposals.reason: The silent subject continues from the son Zhao who was exiled in s0193; Jingsu had already died in s0189.

decisions.reason: Preceding units date Yongzheng 十一/十二年 as 1733/1734, so 十三年 is AD 1735; s0016's 乾隆元年 is 1736. Gaozong's accession in 雍正十三年 is 1735, not 1736.
After 巡撫常鈞庇宏燧, 以七郎呼冤劾兆麟 takes Chang Jun as the subject of 劾, with Qilang's cry of injustice as the pretext; the original wrongly makes Qilang the impeacher.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 巡撫常鈞庇宏燧，以七郎呼冤劾兆麟

decisions.reason: 追咎景素 is posthumous blame of Jingsu; the exile verb 戍 applies to his son 炤 (Zhao), named in s0192. Wikisource/editions read 戍炤 (chapter 戍召 is a graphic garble of 炤), so the original wrongly exiles the already-dead Jingsu.
釋回 has no new subject; it continues from the person exiled in s0193, i.e. Zhao (炤), not the dead Jingsu. Naming Zhao removes the false antecedent.
